senses.gloss: (דייספ׳ Ar., ed. רִיסְפַּק) m. a litter carried by mules (Lat. Basterna).
units: <cite ref="Chullin 79a:13">Ḥull. 79ᵃ</cite> <he>אי מעיילת לי … בד׳</he> when you hitch for me the mules to the litter.
<cite ref="Gittin 55b">Gitt. 55ᵇ</cite>; <cite ref="Gittin 57a:21">57ᵃ</cite> <he>שקא דד׳</he> the shaft of a litter. [Prob. named after the city of Thapsacus.]
